models.name: Traveler's Monobike
models.description:
I dedicated this traveler's bike to the man who made me travel the most during my childhood: Karl May. He himself had never traveled to most of the countries he wrote poems about but enabled others to dive into the landscapes and environements by his storytelling. But if he had have a Monobike with which Old Shatterhand or Kara Ben Nemsi had traveled, it would probably have looked like this one.
Funny side note: The regional license plate of the town in which Karl May was born actually starts with "HOT"
Go & find other references ;)

Based on [Monobike (UV Fix)](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/monobike-uv-fix-0e50b59c92b6406b85255358f7a966dd) by [Warkarma](https://sketchfab.com/warkarma), [Monobike](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/monobike-8e67697cb727446aa073c81464881b35) by [romullus](https://sketchfab.com/romullus), and [Motowheel](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/motowheel-eb238f63754247659a50d52395daf073) by [Costr (Viverna)](https://sketchfab.com/CoStR"), licensed under CC-Attribution. #MonoBikeChallenge

models.name: Yamaha FZH150 Motorbike Model
models.description:
**ABOUT**
This is a Yamaha FZN150 Motorbike Model (in black and grey). It was generated using Agisoft Metashape. The sparse cloud was generated on a high setting, dense cloud on medium, mesh on high (smoothed to 5.00) and the texture at 8000x1.

371 pictures were taken using a Canon EOS M100 (26MP) and a Meike 25mm f/1.8 lens. 
All pictures were taken around noon, at a sheltered rooftop in Singapore.

**SPATIAL REFERENCING**
Using a measuring tape (units in cm), I measured different points on the motorbike. I used 6 different points. My (0, 0, 0) point would be the middle of the bike, on the ground.
1.	From the front wheel to the middle (x-axis)
2.	From the back wheel to the middle (x-axis)
3.	From the handlebar (shorter one due to slant) to the ground (perpendicular)
4.	From the bike box (taller side) to the ground (perpendicular)
5.	From the kickstand to the middle point (y-axis)
6.	From the joint (between the front seat and the engine) (z-axis)
